description: OSeMBE_ECEMF publishes the OSeMBE scenarios used in the European Climate and Energy Modelling Forum and a Snakemake workflow to run OSeMOSYS model inputs. The KTH division of Energy Systems Analysis makes an OSeMOSYS datapackage the workflow input, runs one or more scenarios with a configured Gurobi solver, and converts results to IAMC files. Optional CSV exports contain dual values for constraints. Geographic and temporal coverage follow the OSeMBE scenario datapackage, not an automatically complete European asset inventory. Apache-2.0 workflow source is public, while Gurobi has separate licence requirements. A limitation is that a reproducing user must install compatible dependencies and check the scenario input versions; the workflow does not independently validate the underlying model assumptions. It supports European power and cross-sector pathway comparisons. The catalogue's model-osemosys is the general modelling framework, while this project is a runnable scenario pipeline. No model or data package was downloaded.
